title: Lebel (Paris) to Charles Emmanuel I of Savoy, 17 Jan, 10 and 27 Mar 1593 (BnF fr. 3983 nos. 11, 62, 100)

system.summary: French letter cipher with homophones and nulls plus a numbered code list (groups to 300+); key reconstructed by Tomokiyo from deciphered siblings.
system.notes: Partly-enciphered letters: clear text with enciphered passages.

solution.what: Tomokiyo's savoy.htm lists Lebel's 1593 letters and gives a reconstructed key table (savoy.png).

Deciphered no. 11 (f. 26) with Tomokiyo's key table: reading11.md, many code groups unresolved.
Downloaded Tomokiyo's letter images: f. 26, f. 130, f. 194-195 all carry his decipherment overlaid; the target was already read.

outcome.notes: All three read by Tomokiyo 2017. Catalogue entry 18 removed; no write-up.
